name: 3DCONVERSIONMODE
description: 재료 및 라이트 정의를 최신 제품 릴리즈로 변환하는 데 사용됩니다.

name: 3DDWFPREC
description: 3D DWF 또는 3D DWFx 게시의 정밀도를 조정합니다.

bits.1: Suppresses the current running 3D object snaps
bits.2: Snaps to a vertex or a control vertex
bits.4: Snaps to the midpoint on a face edge
bits.8: Snaps to the center of a face
bits.16: Snaps to a spline or surface knot
bits.32: Snaps to a perpendicular face (planar faces only)
bits.64: Snaps to an object nearest to a face
bits.128: Snaps to the closest point (node) in point cloud
bits.256: Snaps to the nearest point on a planar segment of a point cloud
bits.512: Snaps perpendicular to a planar segment of a point cloud
bits.1024: Snaps to the intersection of inferred lines for a sectioned point cloud, including extrapolated intersections
bits.2048: Snaps to the inferred edge of two planar segments in a point cloud
bits.4096: Snaps perpendicular to the inferred edge of two planar segments in a point cloud
bits.8192: Snaps to the centerline of a cylindrical segment in a point cloud
bits.16384: Snaps to the inferred intersection (corner) of three planar segments in a point cloud

name: 3DSELECTIONMODE
description: 3D 비주얼 스타일을 사용할 때 시각적 및 실제적으로 겹치는 객체의 선택 우선순위를 조정합니다.

name: ACADLSPASDOC
description: acad.lsp 파일 또는 AutoCAD LT용 acadlt.lsp 파일이 모든 도면에 로드되는지 아니면 세션에 열려 있는 첫 번째 도면에만 로드되는지를 조정합니다.
